findings.summary: Hook artifact partitioning still destroys full invocation scope and refuses an otherwise valid bundled carrier.
evidence: scripts/gates/check_issue_closeout_commit_msg.py:380 invokes verification separately for each artifact; its bare-target branch passes only remaining numbers. scripts/prepush_close_keyword_guard.py:388 retains the same partitioned dispatch.

Read-only commit-hook replay held the message constant: Closes #42, #43, complete targeted classifications, targeted behavior, and Critique #42 #43. Bare and combined-artifact inputs passed. Two singleton artifacts failed with missing_issue_bindings:[42]; one artifact plus bare #43 raised 'targeted classifications contain extra/foreign issue numbers: [42]'.

The citation is rejected before its evidence is consumed because _line_numbers sees an artifact subset as the invocation. The composed test covers only one combined staged artifact, leaving this formatting dependency untested.

Verify citations against that full invocation once. Extend the composed fixture to separate artifacts and artifact-plus-bare targets through both hooks.
